architecture.runtime: static site (GitHub Pages), ES modules with an import map, no build step; Node ≥ 20 for tests, Python 3 for data builds

libraries.maplibre: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 (unpkg, pinned with Subresource Integrity; js/shell/maplibre-guard.js)

modules.js/app.js: orchestration: scopes, Aha, panels, map layers, campus file, building camera, URL state, partial notices
modules.js/model.js: decode data/universities.json; measures (students | units), levels, links, pin sizes, filters, summaries, fee words, money
modules.js/area-insight.js: the first Aha (national provinces or a province’s universities; tie rule; open comparison; zero provinces)
modules.js/provinces.js: province fills and outlines (41 samples), focus and selection strokes, province bounds
modules.js/campus.js: decode data/campus.json; campus extents, faculty geometry layers, hit test
modules.js/profile-model.js: overview, site, university, unit, station and building models
modules.js/panel.js: reading panel views as HTML strings (provenance line, no caveat), fee lines, logos
modules.js/pins.js: site pins (HTML at detail, symbols otherwise), context dots
modules.js/labels.js: campus names near the middle of the view, hover cards
modules.js/stations.js: CityMETER · Transit stations as quiet rings, 1 km radius
modules.js/massing.js: focus massing, x-ray inputs, building hit test
modules.js/scales.js: li.supply and count families, 41-sample rank ramp, legend
modules.js/ask.js: Google AI / Maps / Street View actions per view
modules.js/breadcrumb.js: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › campus (DATASET = "")
modules.js/navigation.js: control titles and the pictogram subset

data.data/campus.json: after the first paint or on a campus

rowScopes.scopeRows: reporting units after search · type, before the province selection: the base of the national Aha, the province fill, the province chart
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected province: the province Aha, ranks, type and level bars, the university chart, the table
rowScopes.rows: sites and roster points under the same search · type · province: pins, labels, lists

acceptanceCriteria.expected: 303 units; students add up per level, faculty and sex; ids unique; the period is 2568/2
every unit names a production province; totals add to 1,786,753; 9 provinces measured zero
unique keys; points in a district of their province; a known point role; no point is null, never 0
one unit per site and one site per unit; every link names its rule
extents are the sites’ own; faculty geometry on its site; fee lines with amount, currency and public source; logos equal to their SHA-256
Bangkok, Pathum Thani, Chiang Mai: 55% (988,359 / 1,786,753); without the open type 49% (710,594 / 1,460,444)
never cuts a tie, never every item; follows type and search
measured zero is an outline; every frame takes one of the 41 samples
one symbol per site with a point, never aggregated; labels in the central ellipse, ≤ 9 / 5
every view ends with one provenance line and no caveat
the unit’s students named; faculties; fees as published; no 0 for a campus without a unit; loading said
provinces in the map colour, types with their cue, universities ranked; a click emits its selection
every code of the data reads in words; each amount in its own currency
no Thai left untranslated in any view, pilot campus or province (window.__citymeterI18n.missing empty)
one cache tag; one product version; schema-valid handoff JSON; no spreadsheet, private link, sheet address or credential in the tree
every shipped colour value equals the LDS base file and the Location Intelligence Profile
every published file on GitHub Pages equals the manifest; the live site walks in Chrome
